name: college-administration-platform
description: Production college administration, attendance, issue reporting and communication platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @college/api" "npm run dev -w @college/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @college/shared-types && npm run build -w @college/validation && npm run build -w @college/api && npm run build -w @college/web
scripts.test:all: npm run prisma:validate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run prisma:validate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.docker:infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init
